# King of Freight

King of Freight is a Transportation/Trucking/Railroad company. King of Freight is a full service broker that provides world-class logistics solutions. King of Freight employs 679 people (+3.2% YoY, +21 people), founded in 2008. Headquartered in Wichita, Kansas, United States.

## About

At King of Freight we pride ourselves on being a full service transportation brokerage. Just tell us the type of freight that’s moving and the route it’s moving along, and we will handle the rest. The very second your shipment is scheduled to begin loading, our team of dispatchers is monitoring the load and ensuring everything is moving along as scheduled.

We provide timely updates for our customers in whatever manner they prefer to receive them. Want an email every hour? You got it! Would you rather get a phone call instead? Say no more! Our customers can also track every shipment they have ever done with us via our website. We customize the way we operate around our customers to make shipping with us as hassle free as possible. Upon the shipments delivery, our billing department will track down any necessary paperwork and get it to you right away.

All customers have a www.kingoffreight.com username and password where they can log on and print off any paperwork related to their shipments. Every customer has a direct point of contact. No operators or being transferred from one person to the other. We strive to make your freight related business worry free.
